Method of Attack: Path traversal weakness in Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) exploited to gain remote code execution
Adding maliciously crafted executables to Windows Startup via malicious .diagcab files
Execution of planted executables on system restart to download additional malware payloads
Impacted Systems: All Windows versions under support including Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022
Attack Vector: User interaction via opening malicious email attachments or clicking links to download and run malicious files
Web-based attack hosting specially crafted files on websites or compromised websites
